story_type: sinking fishing boat off Oregon, rescue swimmer alongside, helicopter rescues three
hook: Their fishing boat was going under. Three men were still aboard.
narration: Their fishing boat was going under, and a rescue swimmer was already beside it.
The Flying Fish was sinking off Oregon's Tillamook Bay with three fishermen aboard.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Astoria found it.
They lowered their swimmer into the chop next to the boat.
The swimmer goes into the water so each survivor can be clipped to the hoist, one at a time.
[short pause] One by one, the swimmer brought them out.
outcome: All three fishermen were rescued and taken to Coast Guard Station Tillamook Bay.
title: Fishing boat sinking, 3 men aboard
description:
A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew from Air Station Astoria rescues three fishermen from the sinking fishing vessel Flying Fish near Tillamook Bay, Oregon, July 21, 2015.

facts.claim: Jayhawk crew from Air Station Astoria rescued three fishermen from the sinking Flying Fish near Tillamook Bay, July 21, 2015
facts.source_quote: A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter air crew from Air Station Astoria, Ore., rescues three fishermen from the sinking fishing vessel Flying Fish 19 miles east of Tillamook Bay in the Pacific Ocean, July 21, 2015.

facts.claim: All three rescued, taken to Station Tillamook Bay
facts.source_quote: All three fishermen were rescued and treated by emergency medical technicians at Coast Guard Station Tillamook Bay in Garibaldi, Ore.
